architecture: One application registry composes native collectors, LocalQuerySource and an injected GitNoteLoader/QueryAdapter bridge. Core/SDK continue to own semantic selection, immutable query views, privacy and statistics.
query_scope: --repo PATH --source-adapter git-ai loads refs/notes/ai using standard Git. --source PATH --source-adapter git-ai treats PATH as the explicit repository; returned SourceId can select the same note from the current repository. No separate Git-AI executable, cache, daemon, history union or remote fetch.
identity: SourceId hashes git-ai, git_notes, canonical common repository directory, notes ref and target commit; notes tip and blob are revision, not source identity. NativeLocator pins all five values. Declared attribution session IDs remain repository/source-scoped and never join a transcript by agent display identity.
semantics: Declared sessions may be listed with transcript_available=false. Legacy prompts/humans/unresolved references stay source/event-only. No message/turn/tool/timestamp is invented. Attribution details are consent-gated event parts.
budgets: Query limits are capped by existing native GitNotesLimits defaults. Note input bytes/record/source counts consume the combined budget before native file providers receive the remaining capacity. Native hard safety ceilings are not loosened.
safety: Typed native list/export wrappers use the sole root parser; native OTLP records and native Git error kinds retain their contracts. New file exports stage privately and publish create-new outside canonical repository/Git roots. The upstream Git object reader and SDK collector are unchanged.
proof: Exact merged boot and independent review are pending; prior source proof is historical, not promoted to this subject. Authored app/tests/git_query.rs and testkit proof/git_query.rs cover recipe7, source/ref revision, absent/malformed notes, no fabricated transcript and installed/offline behavior.
